instruction: In can-jump the #:break guard compares reach and i the wrong way. Break when reach is greater than i.
input:
(define (can-jump nums)
  (define max-reach
    (for/fold ([reach 0])
              ([n (in-list nums)]
               [i (in-naturals)])
      #:break (> reach i)
      (max reach (+ n i))))
  (>= max-reach (sub1 (length nums))))
expected:
(define (can-jump nums)
  (define max-reach
    (for/fold ([reach 0])
              ([n (in-list nums)]
               [i (in-naturals)])
      #:break (< reach i)
      (max reach (+ n i))))
  (>= max-reach (sub1 (length nums))))
